messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — I'm prototyping the 'contingency notification' flow for automatic fallback. Main asks: what telemetry do we need surfaced in the operator panel vs. what's just in the audit logs? cc @Maria Chen
Maria Chen: Operators need a short surface: trigger reason, model variant, QPS at time, user-impact estimate, and last successful model version. Keep it scannable. :white_check_mark:
Kevin Patel: +1. Also include sample_rate tag and a replay snapshot id so infra can reproduce decisions.
Jordan Lewis: For the UI, we should have actions: 'acknowledge + annotate' and 'rollback to pinned'. Show a compact timeline. Default UX: monitoring first, not auto-mitigate.
Sara Ortiz: Trigger taxonomy proposal: REQUEST_ERROR, LATENCY_SPIKE, COST_ANOMALY, QUALITY_DETECT. Each maps to severity and suggested action.
Alex Kim: For audit logs we should store the decision trace. Example snapshot we can log (redact prompts):
```
fallback_decision: {
  trigger: "latency_p99>1200ms",
  sampled: true,
  chosen_action: "switch-model",
  from: "redwood/small-v2",
  to: "redwood/medium-q4",
  reason_score: 0.87
}
```
Kevin Patel: Love the trace. Important: strip or hash prompt/PII. Add a redaction_tag and reason for redaction.
deploy-bot: auto-fallback-sim #248 finished — sampled 12/1000 requests, 3 items flagged as requires-operator-ack
Maria Chen: UX nit: operators must be able to filter the audit list by sample_rate and by 'requires_ack'. And a compact timeline card in list view.
Jordan Lewis: Also show a small "why no fallback" view when a candidate fallback was declined by policy; useful for ops post-mortem.
Sara Ortiz: Retention question: keep high-fidelity logs 30 days, then diffs/metadata for 1 year? Ops usually asks for 90/2yr but we should balance cost.
Alex Kim: Proposal: console = summary table + details panel (replay id, annotate, open-in-playground). Audit infra = full blob w/ redaction_tag. Default sampling = 1% (configurable per-customer), operators can bump window to 100% for a limited time.
Kevin Patel: API contract sketch: GET /v1/rollouts/{rollout_id}/fallbacks -> [{trigger_reason, action_taken, sample_id, replay_id, operator_actions, timestamps}]. We should semver this endpoint.
Maria Chen: I'll mock a compact card and a details pane w/ actions. Will attach PNGs to the ticket.
Jordan Lewis: Quick Q: when operator marks an item 'false_positive', should that enqueue a label to the evals pipeline?
Sara Ortiz: Yes — route to evals queue with tag 'operator_false_positive' + replay_id + optional note. Helps ML to refine detectors.
Alex Kim: OK next steps: Maria mock -> Kevin design API payload and redaction flags -> Sara confirm retention policy + KMS notes -> Jordan design ack-state transitions (acknowledged, annotated, escalated, ignored). Weekly check-in Thursday. Thanks everyone :party:
